[[Bjorn Thunderfist]] challenges you to a brawling match.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Speak to Kilroy when you are ready to fight Bjorn Thunderfist.
* Defeat Bjorn Thunderfist in the championship brawling match.
* See Kilroy Stonekin for your reward.

===Reward===
*300 [[Dwarf reputation points]]
*{{skill icon|Ear Bite}}
*{{skill icon|Low Blow}}
*[[Thunderfist's Brass Knuckles]]
:[[Slashing damage|Slashing Dmg]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Inscription]]: None 
:Both hands
*[[Armor of Salvation]]

==Walkthrough==
Once you enter a Norn style ring, the gates will open and [[Bjorn Thunderfist]] will turn hostile to start the single round. You only need to Knock him out once to win.

The easiest way to win is by only auto-attacking without using any skills to build up adrenaline. Keep the Block up whenever possible and interrupt when you can. Use the uppercut, knockdown and combination punch to do damage. You may get knocked out numerous times while slowly wearing him down. Or simply use the skills as in a real boxing fight. [[Brawling Jab]] to break his [[Brawling Block]] defense and then a powerful skill.
